title: Supers as Combat States
creator: guardian42
summary: Activating a Super should feel like entering another form rather than firing a single oversized ability. Your entire kit transforms for twenty to thirty seconds.
question: what-should-supers-become

body.heading: The idea
body.text:
Instead of pressing a button for one large attack, activating your Super temporarily transforms your entire ability kit.

The Super is not the attack. The Super is the state you enter, and everything you already know how to do changes inside it.

body.heading: Why
items: Opens space for cooperative Super interactions

body.text: A Super should change what you can do, not just what you press.

takeaways: The HUD reorganizes around the state, not the icon
Duration replaces burst as the design lever

connections.note: The weapon transformation and HUD transition in this exploration are close to how I imagine entering the state.
Same problem, opposite answer — that one makes Supers rarer and bigger instead.

directions.title: Direction A — Energy Manifestation
directions.note: The Light arrives from outside the Guardian and collects around them.

directions.title: Direction B — Weapon Overcharge
directions.note: The Super grows out of the equipped weapon instead of replacing it.

explorations.process: Prompted for a first-person activation with the HUD reacting before the effect fires.
